purpose: Only experiments requested by v47 feedback 4 and 5
backbone: TCN / A_TCN, same fixed pretrained checkpoint as manuscript Table 1

loss_only.sampling: ordinary shuffled full training set, without preferential high-pool sampling

equal1529.sampling: uniform random subset without target filtering, selection seed = 10000 + fine-tuning seed

excluded: All unrelated previous experiments, alternative operating points, external datasets and new architectures

decoding.new_generation_seed: SHA256 of v47_feedback_04_05|training_seed|temperature:.2f|top_p:.2f; identical between new controls

evaluation: Frozen manuscript three-seed LightGBM Morgan-count ensemble; thresholds -1.5 eV and -4.0 eV; identical per-cell denominators and deduplication; nine-cell mean within seed followed by mean and sample SD across three seeds
interpretation: TCN-specific diagnostic. Size control addresses molecule count, not proof of overfitting mechanism or an optimal threshold. Component ablation compares specified sampling and loss choices and does not establish cross-backbone generality.
